payload.title: M2 Skeleton: Laravel app, workspaces, CI (#2)
payload.objective: Laravel app in Docker with auth, workspace scoping, self-hosted first run, health endpoint and CI. Blocked until the section 13 decisions are confirmed.
successCriteria: Section 13 decisions confirmed and recorded as ADRs
Current stable versions checked and pinned
docker compose up from clean checkout gives working app, horizon, scheduler, postgres, redis
Workspaces and memberships with roles and policies
Global workspace scope with cross-workspace isolation test
Self-hosted first run creates one workspace and owner, registration closed
CI runs Pest, Pint, Larastan and passes
UTC storage tested with Europe/Copenhagen and Africa/Johannesburg
